steps: Create a free Lootup account at lootup.me.
Claim your Daily Loot Chest every day for free points (up to 5,000).
Earn more points with surveys, app installs, games, videos, partner signups, giveaways, and free promo codes.
Optionally complete your Market Research Profile for 50 points and better-matched surveys.
When your points reach the equivalent of $1.00, redeem for a gift card or PayPal cash (crypto via BitPay from $5.10, with a 1% fee).
Gift card and PayPal rewards are processed within 2 business days.
